$comment: Annotated real-world Merlin Program. Adapted from the 'Update page tags' Program registered in haxcms-site-editor-ui.js firstUpdated() and the createEditTagsProgram factory in EditTagsProgram.js. A Program is an Option whose eventName is 'super-daemon-run-program' and whose value.program is an async function. Selecting the entry row launches program mode; each keystroke re-invokes the function (debounced ~150ms) and its returned Option[] replaces the result list. NOTE: 'program' and 'initialValue' are JavaScript functions at runtime — represented here as descriptive strings because JSON cannot encode a function. See README for the authoritative callable signatures.
title: Update page tags

value.name: Update page tags
value.initialValue: async (values) => { const activeItem = toJS(store.activeItem); return (activeItem && activeItem.metadata && activeItem.metadata.tags) || ''; }
value.program: async (input, values) => { const { createEditTagsProgram } = await import('./utils/EditTagsProgram.js'); return createEditTagsProgram(context)(input, values); }
value.$comment_program_returns: The program returns an array of Option-shaped rows. Below is an example of one such row (the 'Save tags' confirm row) as it would appear in the returned array — shown inline for documentation, NOT part of the value object at registration time.

args: new CustomEvent('haxcms-save-node-details', { detail: { id: 'activeItem.id', operation: 'setTags', tags: 'physics, lab' } })
